Competition in market place
*182. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of COMPANY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government considers
promoting competition a serious policy
issue as envisaged in the National Common
Minimum Programme and other statements

and

Support and suggestions from World
Bank on water related issues
*183. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the World Bank has
enhanced the quantum of its loan for
water-related sectors in India from $200
million a year to $800 million a year for
four years;
(b) what are the pre-conditions set
forth by the Bank for extending this loan
package;
(c) whether the World Bank report on
India's performance on water-related
issues, mentions of poor management and
predicts a turbulent future, devoid of
minimum requirement of water to sustain
its economy; and
(d) whether the Bank has recommended
construction of mega dams in the country
to enhance its water storage capacity from
the 30 days of rainfall to 900 days as is
done in major river basins in arid areas of
developed countries?
